reading.the_audit_claim: In `residual_disjoint_bands`, the filter `*threshold > 0 && *threshold < ceiling && max_damage >= *threshold && min_roll < *threshold` admits nothing when every residual threshold lies below the fan minimum, so `applicable_len == 0`, the function returns `None`, and the arm is priced at the survive representative.
reading.verified: CONFIRMED, and by direct instrumentation rather than by reading. The only call carrying a threshold at all is `(max_damage 159, min_roll 135, thresholds [82], ceiling 157)`. `min_roll < *threshold` is `135 < 82`, FALSE, so `applicable` is empty, `applicable_len == 0`, and the function returns `None`.
reading.and_one_thing_the_audit_did_not_say: The two call sites C149's split actually touches -- the ones whose `ceiling` argument is `i16::MAX` -- are reached on this boundary with an EMPTY threshold slice. So the split is unreachable here twice over: not merely filtered out, but with nothing to filter. The call that does carry a threshold is at `ceiling = defender_active.hp = 157`, which is one of the two sites C149 deliberately left alone.
reading.band_and_representative: `max_damage 159` with `ceiling 157` gives the 14-roll survive band the ledger records, and `sum(band) // len(band) = 145`, which is not a member of the exact integer fan `floor(159 * r / 100)`.
